lead: Sanjay Gandhi was an Indian politician, born on 14 December 1946 in New Delhi.
He died on 23 June 1980 in New Delhi at the age of 33.
He has held the office of Member of the 7th Lok Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Sanjay Gandhi: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Sanjay Gandhi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sanjay Gandhi was born on 14 December 1946 in New Delhi, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Feroze Gandhi and his mother, Indira Gandhi. He is a sibling of Rajiv Gandhi.
His listed education includes The Doon School and Welham Boys' School.

sections.heading: Sanjay Gandhi — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.
He has held the following offices: Member of the 7th Lok Sabha (1980–1980). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.

sections.heading: Sanjay Gandhi — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He was married to Maneka Gandhi.
He is a parent to Varun Gandhi.
